concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-multi-pay-in-receive-funds]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace guide to allowlisted pay-in-partner bank payouts into the Adyen-held multi pay-in account, incoming bank/transaction webhook evidence and later allocation boundary; authorized example's top-level status conflicts with its prose.
warnings: The incoming partner payout and booked credit belong to the multi pay-in staging account; they do not prove allocation into users' balance accounts.

In the authorized webhook example, prose and nested event say authorised but top-level data.status remains received. In the booked TEST Transfer example, nested events[].transactionId differs from top-level data.transactionId, which matches the Transaction webhook data.id; do not infer a universal join-key rule. The next-step top-up link points to /refunds.
